module_summary: 4-state FSM controller for walking figure: transitions between walking-left, walking-right, or falling states based on ground contact and directional bumps.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 4-state FSM register encoding walking directions (WL, WR) and falling states (FALLL, FALLR).

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: FSM-decoded output: high when state equals WL (walking left).

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: FSM-decoded output: high when state equals WR (walking right).

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: FSM-decoded output: high when state is FALLL or FALLR (falling).

groups.name: Walk/fall controller
groups.description: 4-state FSM managing walking direction and falling detection.

groups.name: State outputs
groups.description: FSM-decoded status outputs for walk left, walk right, and falling modes.
